mapper.select: SELECT CONCAT(warning_order_id, '') AS warningOrderId, alarm_body AS alarmBody, msg_type AS msgType, importance_level AS importanceLevel, IF(alarm_time IS NULL, '', DATE_FORMAT(alarm_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')) AS alarmTime, latitude, longitude, ptz_z AS zoom, ptz_p AS pan, ptz_t AS tilt, comp_confidence_level AS compConfidenceLevel, device_code AS deviceCode, device_name AS deviceName, channel_code AS channelCode, channel_name AS channelName, alarm_code AS alarmCode, algorithm_code AS algorithmCode, warning_type_id AS warningTypeId, warning_source AS warningSource, task_id AS taskId, video_url AS videoUrl, file_img_url_src AS fileImgUrlSrc, file_img_url_icon AS fileImgUrlIcon, industry_code AS industryCode, scene_template AS sceneTemplate, tenant_id AS tenantId, tenant_name AS tenantName, address, province_code AS provinceCode, city_code AS cityCode, county_code AS countyCode FROM ${tableName} WHERE delete_flag = '0' AND ai_judge_status = 0 ORDER BY alarm_time ASC LIMIT #{limit}
